news.title: Liam Delap departs for Nottingham Forest
news.title_zh: 利亚姆·德拉普出发前往诺丁汉森林
news.body_en: Liam Delap has today completed a permanent transfer to Nottingham Forest. The striker arrived at Stamford Bridge last June and was a member of our victorious FIFA Club World Cup squad that summer. He featured in six of our seven games and started in four. Last season, Delap played 41 times for us across four different competitions, netting against Barcelona at Stamford Bridge and Fulham away from home. We would like to wish Liam well in the next chapter of his career.
news.body_zh: 利亚姆·德拉普今天完成了向诺丁汉森林的永久转会。这位前锋去年六月抵达斯坦福桥，并成为我们那年夏天赢得国际足联俱乐部世界杯的球队的一员。他在我们的七场比赛中出场了六场，并在四场比赛中首发。上赛季，德拉普在四场不同的比赛中为我们出场41次，在斯坦福桥对阵巴塞罗那和客场对阵富勒姆的比赛中进球。我们祝愿利亚姆在他职业生涯的下一个篇章中一切顺利。

news.title: Debutant named Star of the Match against Sociedad
news.title_zh: 首秀被评为对阵皇家队的比赛之星
news.body_en: The votes have been counted and we can now reveal who has been named the Chelsea Star of the Match in our 5-2 victory over Real Sociedad on Wednesday. The Blues took a big step towards qualifying for the Champions League proper by beating the Spanish side in our first home game at Plough Lane, producing a dynamic attacking display after the break. You voted for Melvine Malard as your standout performer on the night, with the French debutant picking up 37 per cent of the vote after her two clinical second-half goals. Not far behind Malard was another goalscorer, Lauren James. She got 32 per cent of the vote while the ever-threatening Ellie Carpenter, architect of our final two goals on the night, received 22 per cent. Be there to welcome CFCW to our new home at Stamford Bridge when we take on Aston Villa in our first Women's Super League match of the season on 5 September at 12.35pm!
news.body_zh: 计票已经结束，我们现在可以揭晓谁在周三 5-2 战胜皇家社会的比赛中被评为切尔西全场最佳之星。蓝军在普劳巷的第一场主场比赛中击败了西班牙球队，在中场休息后展现出充满活力的进攻表现，从而朝着获得欧洲冠军联赛资格迈出了一大步。你们把梅尔文·马拉德选为当晚表现最出色的球员，这位法国新人在下半场的两个冷静进球后获得了 37% 的选票。紧随马拉德身后不远的是另一位进球者劳伦·詹姆斯。她获得了 32% 的选票，而当晚最后两个进球的缔造者、极具威胁性的埃莉·卡彭特 (Ellie Carpenter) 则获得了 22% 的选票。 9 月 5 日中午 12 点 35 分，我们将在本赛季首场女子超级联赛对阵阿斯顿维拉的比赛中欢迎 CFCW 来到我们位于斯坦福桥的新家！

news.title: Chelsea vs Luton: All you need to know
news.title_zh: 切尔西 vs 卢顿：您需要知道的一切
news.body_en: Chelsea host Luton Town in a 7.30pm kick-off (UK time) in round two of the Carabao Cup. Club historian Rick Glanvill and club statistician Paul Dutton look ahead to the Blues' first knockout tie of 2026/27. The fixture was moved to a less familiar Thursday slot to accommodate Monday’s trip to Fulham – a 3-2 Premier League victory for the Blues. This first-ever League Cup meeting between the two clubs is the setting for new manager Xabi Alonso’s official debut in front of the Stamford Bridge faithful – travelling Chelsea supporters have already chanted his name at Craven Cottage. The Blues are the capital’s most successful contestants in the tri-handled trophy with five wins, and we most recently contested the final in 2024. Back in December, our quarter-final victory at Cardiff City made it 19 straight wins against lower-league opponents in this floodlit trophy quest. The Blues then bowed out at the semi-final stage to eventual runners-up Arsenal. Luton’s greatest moment of giant-killing came in defeating the Gunners in the 1988 final of this competition. They last encountered top-flight opposition in the League Cup in September 2020, losing 3-0 to Manchester United – one of eight losses in the past nine encounters with top-flight opponents in this competition. Prior to beating Gillingham this month, the third-tier Hatters had been eliminated in round one of the Carabao Cup for three seasons in a row. All round-two games are broadcast live on Sky Sports platforms and this one is on Sky Sports channels 401 and 402, and their app. Wesley Fofana is suspended, while Xabi Alonso confirmed that both Moises Caicedo and Marco Palestra will miss Thursday’s Carabao Cup clash. Elsewhere, the Spaniard stated that goalkeeper Mike Penders has an opportunity to feature. ‘Let’s see, hopefully Moi could make it for the weekend, but we need to check a little bit more with Marco,' said Alonso in his pre-match press conference. ‘Otherwise everyone from Monday is okay, Cole [Palmer] is absolutely fine. Penders is part of the squad, so he has an opportunity. We will decide and then I am giving the team tomorrow to the players, so I prefer to respect that they know first.' In our history, Chelsea have exited at this stage of the competition on 13 occasions, though not since October 1995, to Stoke City over two legs. There were some memorable round-two matches in the early years of the competition, not least 3-0 away to Birmingham City on 23 September 1966, when Jim McCalliog became one of the club’s youngest debutants on his 18th birthday. The same month three years later, local visitors Charlton Athletic were thrashed 5-2 and the Blues also hit the bar four times. The clash with Sheffield Wednesday in 1970 required a replay, in which Dave Sexton’s regular ploy of throwing Dave Webb up front paid off. The utility man netted the winner for 2-1. In 1984, over two legs, John Neal’s side took what proved an unassailable 3-1 lead to Millwall’s Den, Kerry Dixon levelling in a 1-1 draw. We went on to reach the semi-finals. A shock 1-0 first leg-loss at York City was thankfully overturned 3-0 at the Bridge in 1986. The Londoners had a reputation for embarrassing defeats by lower league sides and rarely did that jinx hurt more than a 3-1 second-leg loss at Tranmere Rovers in 1991. A 5-4 aggregate victory over Blackpool in 1996 would prove our last round-two entry for 20 years, until a feisty Bristol Rovers outfit were edged out 3-2 on the Fulham Road, Michy Batshuayi bagging a brace. Our most recent match at the stage came in 2023, against Wimbledon. The Wombles took the lead through a penalty but succumbed 2-1 after a spot-kick in reply from Noni Madueke and an Enzo Fernandez winner into an empty net. Luton Town’s last win at the Bridge was through a penalty shootout in the little-regarded Zenith Data Systems Cup in February 1991. The Hatters’ most recent Fulham Road visit was a 3-0 Premier League loss in 2023, with Raheem Sterling (twice) and Nicolas Jackson finding the net. Chelsea are London’s most successful club in this competition, winning it five times, including the capital’s first and most recent successes.  Our ten League Cup final appearances is bettered only by Liverpool (15). Chelsea and Luton have met 47 times previously across all competitions, the Blues winning 21 of those encounters. We have prevailed in each of the past five meetings between the two on all fronts, starting with the 1994 FA Cup semi-final at Wembley. Chelsea’s record victory in this competition remains the 7-0 win at Doncaster Rovers on 16 November 1960, during our maiden League Cup campaign. Our two previous second-round appearances were also at Stamford Bridge, the 3-2 win over Bristol Rovers in 2016 and the 2-1 success against Wimbledon in 2023. Luton are playing their last few seasons at their quirky Kenilworth Road home, while a 25,000-seater stadium emerges in the town centre. Goal-line technology and VAR will not be in operation until the semi-finals, unless all host stadiums in the round are suitably equipped. Nine substitutes can be named and five used in the game (plus a concussion replacement if required). Yellow cards and suspensions apply only to this competition. Red card bans are served across all domestic fronts. Players are no longer cup tied if they move from one club to another during a transfer window. Each tie is decided on the night and extra-time is not used to decide ties until the second leg of the semi-finals.  In the event of scores being level after second-half stoppage time, the outcome will be decided by a penalty shoot-out.
news.body_zh: 联赛杯第二轮比赛晚上 7 点 30 分（英国时间），切尔西队主场迎战卢顿镇队。俱乐部历史学家里克·格兰维尔和俱乐部统计学家保罗·达顿展望蓝军 2026/27 赛季的首场淘汰赛。比赛被移至不太熟悉的周四时段，以适应周一对阵富勒姆的比赛——蓝军在英超联赛中以 3-2 获胜。两家具乐部之间的首次联赛杯比赛是新任主教练哈维·阿隆索在斯坦福桥球迷面前的正式首秀——切尔西球迷已经在克雷文小屋高喊他的名字。蓝军是首都最成功的三把手奖杯参赛者，取得了五场胜利，我们最近一次参加决赛是在 2024 年。早在 12 月，我们在卡迪夫城的四分之一决赛中取得胜利，在这场灯光奖杯争夺战中连续 19 场战胜低级别联赛对手。蓝军随后在半决赛阶段输给了最终的亚军阿森纳。卢顿最伟大的巨人杀戮时刻是在1988年的这项赛事决赛中击败枪手。他们上次在联赛杯中遭遇顶级对手是在2020年9月，当时0-3不敌曼联，这是过去9次在联赛杯中与顶级对手交锋的8场失利之一。在本月击败吉林汉姆之前，三级联赛的帽子队已经连续三个赛季在联赛杯第一轮被淘汰。所有第二轮比赛均在天空体育平台直播，本场比赛在天空体育频道 401 和 402 及其应用程序上直播。韦斯利·福法纳被停赛，而哈维·阿隆索确认莫伊塞斯·凯塞多和马科·帕莱斯特拉都将缺席周四的联赛杯比赛。在其他地方，西班牙人表示门将迈克·彭德斯有机会出场。阿隆索在赛前新闻发布会上说：“让我们看看，希望莫伊能够度过周末，但我们需要与马科进行更多检查。” “除此之外，从周一开始大家都还好，科尔（帕尔默）绝对没问题。彭德斯是球队的一员，所以他有机会。我们将做出决定，然后我将明天的球队交给球员，所以我更愿意尊重他们首先知道的事情。”在我们的历史上，切尔西已经有 13 次在这个阶段的比赛中出局，不过自 1995 年 10 月以来就没有这样了，当时是两回合输给斯托克城。比赛初期有一些令人难忘的第二轮比赛，尤其是 1966 年 9 月 23 日客场 3-0 战胜伯明翰城的比赛，当时吉姆·麦卡利奥格 (Jim McCalliog) 在他 18 岁生日时成为俱乐部最年轻的首发球员之一。三年后的同月，当地客队查尔顿竞技队以 5-2 惨败，蓝军也四次击中横梁。 1970 年与谢菲尔德星期三队的比赛需要重赛，戴夫·塞克斯顿将戴夫·韦伯扔到前场的常规策略得到了回报。这位公用事业人以 2-1 的比分获胜。 1984 年，在两回合比赛中，约翰·尼尔的球队以 3-1 无可争议的优势领先米尔沃尔的登恩队，克里·迪克森 (Kerry Dixon) 1-1 扳平比分。我们继续进入半决赛。首回合令人震惊地 1-0 负于约克城，幸好 1986 年在蓝桥以 3-0 被逆转。伦敦人因被低级别联赛球队惨败而闻名，这种厄运很少比 1991 年第二回合 1-3 输给特兰米尔流浪者更严重。1996 年以 5-4 总比分战胜布莱克浦将证明我们 20 年来最后一次进入第二轮比赛，直到充满活力的布里斯托尔流浪者队在富勒姆路以 3-2 击败对手，米奇·巴舒亚伊 (Michy Batshuayi) 梅开二度。我们最近一次在舞台上的比赛是 2023 年对阵温布尔登的比赛。沃布尔队通过点球取得领先，但诺尼·马杜克的点球和恩佐·费尔南德斯的制胜球打入空门，最终以 2-1 落败。卢顿镇上一次在蓝桥取得胜利是在 1991 年 2 月举行的、鲜为人知的实力数据系统杯比赛中，通过点球大战取得胜利。帽子队最近一次造访富勒姆路是在 2023 年英超联赛中，球队以 3-0 失利，拉希姆·斯特林（两次）和尼古拉斯·杰克逊进球。切尔西是伦敦在这项赛事中最成功的俱乐部，五次获胜，包括伦敦的首次和最近的成功。我们十次进入联赛杯决赛，仅次于利物浦（15 次）。切尔西和卢顿此前在所有比赛中交锋过 47 次，蓝军赢了其中 21 场。从 1994 年在温布利举行的足总杯半决赛开始，我们在过去五次两队交锋中都取得了胜利。 切尔西在这场比赛中的创纪录胜利仍然是 1960 年 11 月 16 日我们首次参加联赛杯期间以 7-0 战胜唐卡斯特流浪者队。我们之前的两次第二轮比赛也是在斯坦福桥进行的，分别是 2016 年 3-2 战胜布里斯托尔流浪者队和 2023 年 2-1 战胜温布尔登队。卢顿在他们奇特的凯尼尔沃斯路主场度过了最后几个赛季，而市中心则出现了一座可容纳 25,000 名观众的体育场。门线技术和 VAR 直到半决赛才会投入使用，除非本轮所有主办体育场都配备了适当的设备。可以指定九名替补球员，并在比赛中使用五名替补球员（如果需要，还可以加上一名脑震荡替补球员）。黄牌和禁赛仅适用于本场比赛。红牌禁令适用于国内所有战线。如果球员在转会窗口期间从一个俱乐部转会到另一家具乐部，则不再受到杯赛限制。每场比赛均在当晚决出胜负，直到半决赛第二回合才通过加时赛决出胜负。如果下半场补时后双方打平，则通过点球大战决定胜负。

news.title: Quenda on settling in England and first impressions of Chelsea
news.title_zh: 昆达谈在英格兰定居以及对切尔西的第一印象
news.body_en: Geovany Quenda introduces himself to the Chelsea supporters with an exclusive interview in the programme for our first home game of the season against Luton Town in the Carabao Cup. The Portuguese winger made his competitive debut as a substitute against Fulham at Craven Cottage on Monday and tells us about his close friendship with Dario Essugo, the encouragement he has received from Xabi Alonso and the 'family' atmosphere at Cobham. 'We had a good pre-season and I think now it’s about making sure we also have a good start to the season,' he says of his first few weeks as a Blue. 'For me, I just need to help the team. That’s the most important thing – help the team to win. Of course, it’s difficult to come to another country, but this is my job.' Quenda also talks about his journey from Guinea-Bissau to the Premier League, via Sporting Lisbon, where so many other great players in his position emerged in the past couple of generations, from Luis Figo to Cristiano Ronaldo. We also delve into the distant past and uncover the long-forgotten stories of two Luton Town goal machines who swapped Kenilworth Road for Stamford Bridge either side of the Second World War. Joe Payne and Hugh Billington were two of the great goal scorers of their time, and we take a deeper look into their lives, with help from the research of Billington’s distant relative and genealogist, Kai Ridds. We also relive the 1994 FA Cup semi-final, when Chelsea legend Kerry Dixon came up against his former side with Luton Town at Wembley. Then there’s all the usual columns, news and stats, bringing you fresh insight and keeping you up to date with the latest goings on at the club. Buy your copy from the programme sellers around Stamford Bridge, or order online from our official publications partner, Reach Sport.
news.body_zh: 乔瓦尼·昆达在我们本赛季首场主场对阵卢顿镇的卡拉宝杯比赛的节目中接受了独家采访，向切尔西球迷介绍了自己。这位葡萄牙边锋周一在克拉文小屋对阵富勒姆的比赛中替补登场，完成了他的正式比赛首秀，并向我们讲述了他与达里奥·埃苏戈的亲密友谊、哈维·阿隆索对他的鼓励以及科巴姆的“家庭”氛围。 “我们在季前备战中表现出色，我认为现在的重点是确保我们在赛季中有一个良好的开局，”他在谈到自己作为蓝军的头几周时说道。 “对我来说，我只需要帮助球队。这是最重要的事情——帮助球队获胜。当然，来到另一个国家很困难，但这是我的工作。”昆达还谈到了他从几内亚比绍通过里斯本竞技队进入英超联赛的旅程，在过去的几代人中，从路易斯·菲戈到克里斯蒂亚诺·罗纳尔多，许多其他伟大的球员在他的位置上涌现。我们还深入研究了遥远的过去，揭开了卢顿镇两台进球机器被遗忘已久的故事，它们在第二次世界大战期间将凯尼尔沃斯路换成了斯坦福桥。乔·佩恩和休·比林顿是他们那个时代最伟大的两位进球手，我们在比林顿的远亲兼系谱学家凯·里兹的研究帮助下，更深入地了解了他们的生活。我们还重温了 1994 年足总杯半决赛，当时切尔西传奇人物克里·迪克森 (Kerry Dixon) 在温布利对阵他的前东家卢顿镇 (Luton Town)。然后还有所有常见的专栏、新闻和统计数据，为您带来新鲜的见解，让您了解俱乐部的最新动态。从斯坦福桥周边的节目销售商处购买副本，或从我们的官方出版物合作伙伴 Reach Sport 在线订购。

news.title: Xabi Alonso says Blues duo in contention to face Luton
news.title_zh: 哈维·阿隆索表示蓝军二人组将争夺对阵卢顿的机会
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso has confirmed Danny Welbeck and Emmanuel Emegha could make their Chelsea debuts when we take on Luton Town in the second round of the Carabao Cup. The attacking duo didn’t feature in our final friendly, against Real Sociedad, nor our Premier League opener at Craven Cottage earlier in the week, when Welbeck was an unused substitute. Our manager had positive news on their fitness, but confirmed the game will come too soon for another new signing, Jordan Henderson. ‘Danny and Emma, yes [they will be in contention to face Luton],’ said Alonso. ‘Jordan will take a little bit longer. Let's see. I'm not a doctor and I don't have the data. We need to wait until we know more.' It is still early days for Alonso at Chelsea, but the early signs in our victory at Craven Cottage were very promising indeed. Our new manager knows there is plenty of work ahead to mould this Blues team in his image, but he is confident to see consistent progress as the campaign unfolds. 'Most of the teams will get better and better in the weeks ahead and with more games,’ said Alonso. ‘We have some players that have just been back for two weeks, they are in good shape but they will get better. 'There are teams that have been working longer with their manager and so many ideas are already very established. With other projects, in different cases, it takes more time. So there will be a development of many concepts. 'As I said in another press conference, I think that we started our season Monday and the way we will be playing in January will be different. And I think it's going to be better, and the next year will be even better.'
news.body_zh: 哈比·阿隆索确认丹尼·维尔贝克和伊曼纽尔·埃梅加可以在卡拉宝杯第二轮对阵卢顿镇时首次亮相切尔西。这对进攻组合没有出现在我们对阵皇家社会队的最后一场友谊赛中，也没有出现在本周早些时候我们在克雷文小屋举行的英超揭幕战中，当时维尔贝克是一名未上场的替补球员。我们的主教练对他们的健康状况有积极的消息，但他也确认，对于另一位新签约球员乔丹·亨德森来说，这场比赛来得太早了。 “丹尼和艾玛，是的（他们将争夺对阵卢顿的比赛），”阿隆索说。 “乔丹需要更长的时间。让我们来看看。我不是医生，我没有数据。我们需要等待，直到了解更多。对于阿隆索在切尔西来说还处于早期阶段，但我们在克雷文小屋取得胜利的早期迹象确实非常有希望。我们的新主教练知道要按照他的形象塑造这支蓝军还有很多工作要做，但他有信心随着赛季的展开看到持续的进展。阿隆索说：“在接下来的几周里，随着比赛的增多，大多数球队都会变得越来越好。” “我们有一些球员刚刚回归两周，他们的状态很好，但他们会变得更好。 “有些团队与他们的经理合作的时间更长，很多想法已经非常成熟。对于其他项目，在不同情况下，需要更多时间。所以会有很多概念的发展。 “正如我在另一场新闻发布会上所说，我认为我们的赛季是周一开始的，一月份我们的比赛方式将会有所不同。我认为情况会更好，明年会更好。”

news.title: Chelsea learn potential Carabao Cup third round opponents
news.title_zh: 切尔西了解卡拉宝杯第三轮的潜在对手
news.body_en: Should we progress past Luton Town in the Carabao Cup tomorrow, we will play at Stamford Bridge in the third round of the competition. The draw was made after Everton’s victory at Preston North End and it handed Xabi Alonso’s side a potential tie against Leeds United, who defeated Nottingham Forest in the second round. It would be our third League Cup tie against Leeds, following victories in 1969, 2001 and, most memorably, 2012, when we won 5-1 at Elland Road in the quarter-finals. Third-round ties will be split across two midweek slots to accommodate European fixture commitments, with games played on the weeks beginning 7 September and 14 September. news.body_en: Chelsea assistant coach Camille Abily hailed our wealth of resources in attack as our new number nine Melvine Malard scored a brace on her debut in our 5-2 win over Real Sociedad at Plough Lane on Wednesday. The striker combined with former Lyon teammate Ellie Carpenter for her second of the evening, the pair having worked under Abily and head coach Sonia Bompastor at the French club in the past. ‘They know each other really well,’ said Abily, who was deputising on the touchline for the suspended Bompastor. ‘They also get on really well. They speak in French sometimes, so it helps because no one understands. ‘It would be great anytime we are able to score five goals. Of course, we have quality on the pitch, and also on the bench, because today the subs helped the team a lot. ‘Up front, we have Melvine. We have Mayra (Ramirez). She's not here yet, but I hope she will be soon. Aggie (Beever-Jones) is able to play this position. Last year, Lauren James played in this position. ‘That wasn't what we wanted, but when we are missing forwards sometimes we need it. Melvine is really versatile. She's able to play different positions and Aggie also, so it can help the team.’ Sociedad took the lead after just seven minutes, and fought back to level the scores at 2-2 before we extended our lead in the latter stages of the contest. Abily paid tribute to the opposition, and explained some of the half-time tactical tweaks she made to turn the performance around. ‘It was a tough game,’ she said. ‘Especially in the first half because Real Sociedad are a really great team, but I think we had a good reaction. We were so much better in the second half. There was also more space for us. So a tough win, but a good win. ‘At half-time we said we wanted to find and play in the spaces behind because their back line was really high. We score many goals like this, so this is sort of what we want to do, so it was good. ‘It was a good experience on the touchline. It was fun, but it's okay. Sonia can take the spot again!’ Finally, the assistant coach explained why defender Naomi Girma was replaced by Lucy Bronze in the second half. ‘It's more fitness,’ she said. ‘And also a decision because we have many good players on the bench, and we know with her calf we need to be careful. So for that, we didn’t want to take any risks.'
news.body_zh: 切尔西助理教练卡米尔·阿比利称赞我们在进攻方面拥有丰富的资源，周三我们在普洛巷 5-2 战胜皇家社会的比赛中，我们的新九号球员梅尔文·马拉德在首秀中梅开二度。这位前锋与前里昂队友埃莉·卡彭特一起度过了当晚的第二场比赛，两人过去曾在法国俱乐部的阿比利和主教练索尼娅·邦帕斯特手下工作过。 “他们彼此非常了解，”阿比利说，他是被停赛的邦帕斯托在边线的代表。 ‘他们也相处得很好。他们有时会说法语，所以这很有帮助，因为没有人听得懂。 “任何时候我们能够进五个球就太棒了。当然，我们在场上和替补席上都有实力，因为今天替补给了球队很大帮助。 “在前面，我们有梅尔文。我们有梅拉（拉米雷斯）。她还没来，但我希望她很快就会来。阿吉（比弗-琼斯饰）能够胜任这个职位。去年，劳伦·詹姆斯担任过这个职位。 `这不是我们想要的，但当我们缺少前锋时，有时我们需要它。梅尔文真是多才多艺。她能够胜任不同的位置，阿吉也能胜任，所以这对球队有帮助。仅仅七分钟后，社会队就取得了领先，并反击将比分扳成2-2平，随后我们在比赛后期扩大了领先优势。阿比利向对手致敬，并解释了她为扭转局面而做出的一些半场战术调整。 “这是一场艰难的比赛，”她说。 “特别是在上半场，因为皇家社会是一支非常出色的球队，但我认为我们的反应很好。下半场我们表现好多了。我们也有更多的空间。所以这是一场艰难的胜利，但也是一场美好的胜利。 “半场结束时，我们说我们想找到后面的空间并进行比赛，因为他们的后防线非常高。我们打进了很多这样的进球，所以这就是我们想做的事情，所以这很好。 “在边线上这是一次很好的经历。这很有趣，但没关系。最后，助理教练解释了为什么下半场后卫娜奥米·吉尔玛被露西·布朗泽换下。 “这更适合健身，”她说。 “这也是一个决定，因为我们的替补席上有很多优秀的球员，我们知道对于她的小腿，我们需要小心。因此，我们不想冒任何风险。”

news.title_zh: 比赛战报：切尔西 5-2 皇家社会
news.body_en: Melvine Malard scored a brace on her Chelsea debut as we battled back to take a 5-2 advantage into the second leg of our Women's Champions League qualifier with Real Sociedad. It soon became apparent that Real Sociedad would not be easy to overcome as Ainhoa Marin scored with a stunning looping strike after just seven minutes. Naomi Girma then put us back on even ground with a header from a Katie McCabe corner, but the Blues went in at the interval with the scores locked at 1-1. The second half saw Chelsea emerge with renewed vigour, Sjoeke Nusken seeing her attempt ruled out for offside before young defender Veerle Buurman rose up to deliver a powerful header across the line soon afterwards. Our Spanish visitors fought back almost immediately, Cecilia Marcos' strike putting Sociedad back on even terms. That Sociedad were so determined made what happened next all the more impressive. An inch-perfect through-ball from Nusken picked out Melvine Malard, allowing her to slot home on her debut. Next came a wonderful run from Ellie Carpenter down the right as she then picked out Lauren James in the box and the forward made no mistake with her emphatic finish. An exceptional evening in Wimbledon concluded with our fifth goal. Carpenter once again powered down the flank, delivering a cross for Malard, who marked her first competitive appearance in Blue in some style. Head coach Sonia Bompastor was serving a suspension for this match, leaving assistant Camille Abily to take charge of the team. And the match began with Chelsea in firm control of possession and dictating the tempo of play. Yet, after captain for the evening Naomi Girma had confidently shepherded a through-ball into touch, it was the Spanish side who took the lead thanks to a moment of brilliance from Ainhoa Marin. The Sociedad number eight received the ball on the corner of the penalty area, lofting it over the outstretched Hannah Hampton before the ball nestled perfectly in the far corner, putting the visitors ahead with only seven minutes on the clock. Chelsea still had plenty of attacking intent, and Sandy Baltimore was unlucky not to level the scores when she smashed an attempt onto the underside of the crossbar. The woodwork then came to the rescue for the Blues at the opposite end when Sociedad fired another dangerous shot towards goal, but the offside flag soon went up. The equaliser came from a well-worked set piece. McCabe, on her full debut for the Blues, took the inswinging corner for captain Girma to flick the ball up and over the goalkeeper with a header with 30 minutes gone. Moments later, the Blues almost went ahead when Aggie Beever-Jones received the ball in space inside the box, but she dragged her shot just wide of the left-hand post. The Spanish side were providing a real test: well-organised, positionally disciplined and working hard to keep us at bay. For that reason, Chelsea went in at 1-1 when the half-time whistle blew, and there was more work to be done after the interval. Shortly after the restart, Sjoeke Nusken had the ball in the back of the net, but the flag was raised to swiftly rule it out.  And when James took a dangerous corner-kick, Buurman rose high above every player inside the box to nod down a pinpoint header to put us ahead for the first time in the contest. But that lead would last just four minutes when Marcos rifled in a right-footed effort from inside the box, and the scores were tied once more. Chelsea weren't done, though. When Wieke Kaptein laid the ball off for Nusken 20 yards from goal, the Germany international played a perfect through ball for debutant Melvine Malard, allowing the France international to round the goalkeeper and slot home. There was a sense that Real Sociedad were tiring, and when Carpenter powered down the line, her defender slipped at the crucial moment, allowing the Australian to pull the ball back for the onrushing James, who finished emphatically under the crossbar. Chelsea were now in the ascendancy, and substitute Maika Hamano was inches away from connecting with a pass that would've given the goalkeeper a stern test with ten to play. Taking a two-goal lead into the second leg would've been good enough, but an almost carbon-copy of James' goal extended our advantage even further. Carpenter advanced down the channel again, her pace beating her marker, when she squared the ball across the box for former-Lyon team-mate Malard. Our new number nine had a brace on her debut, a sure sign of things to come from the striker. We head into the second leg in San Sebastian on Wednesday 2 September with a three-goal cushion. We travel to Spain to face the return leg of this Women's Champions League qualifier against Real Sociedad, before we face Aston Villa at home on Saturday 5 September at Stamford Bridge, our first Women's Super League clash of the season. You can purchase your tickets for that exciting home game here. news.body_zh: 梅尔文·马拉德在切尔西首秀中梅开二度，帮助我们在与皇家社会队的女子冠军联赛预选赛第二回合中以 5-2 领先。很快我们就发现，皇家社会队并不容易被击败，仅仅七分钟后，阿伊霍亚·马林就以一记令人惊叹的弧线球进球。随后，凯蒂·麦凯布 (Katie McCabe) 开出角球，纳奥米·吉尔玛 (Naomi Girma) 头球攻门，帮助球队扳平比分，但蓝军在中场休息时将比分锁定为 1-1。下半场切尔西重新焕发活力，舍克·努斯肯的尝试因越位被判无效，随后年轻后卫维尔勒·布尔曼站起来，在门线附近射出一记强有力的头球。我们的西班牙客队几乎立即发起反击，塞西莉亚·马科斯的进球让社会队扳平了比分。皇家社会如此坚定，让接下来发生的事情更加令人印象深刻。努斯肯一记完美的直塞球挑中了梅尔文·马拉德，让她在首秀中打进了主场。接下来，埃莉·卡彭特（Ellie Carpenter）在右路进行了精彩的跑动，随后她在禁区内找到了劳伦·詹姆斯（Lauren James），这位前锋的大力射门毫无失误。温布尔登的一个非凡夜晚以我们的第五个进球结束。卡彭特再次压制了侧翼，为马拉德传中，马拉德以某种方式首次代表蓝色队参加比赛。主教练索尼娅·邦帕斯托因本场比赛停赛，由助理教练卡米尔·阿比利负责球队。比赛一开始，切尔西就牢牢控制了控球权，主导了比赛的节奏。然而，在当晚队长内奥米·吉尔玛自信地将直塞球送入界外后，西班牙队凭借阿伊霍亚·马林的精彩表现取得了领先。皇家社会队八号球员在禁区一角接到球，将球越过伸展开来的汉娜·汉普顿，然后球完美地落入远角，在比赛还剩七分钟时，客队领先。切尔西仍然有充足的进攻意图，而桑迪·巴尔的摩则不幸未能将比分扳平，因为她的射门击中了横梁下方。当皇家社会队再次向球门射出危险射门时，门框在另一端为蓝军提供了救援，但越位旗很快就升了起来。均衡器来自一个精心设计的定位球。麦凯布在蓝军首次亮相，在比赛还剩30分钟时，队长吉尔马开出内旋角球，皮球越过门将头球攻门。过了一会儿，当阿吉·比弗-琼斯在禁区内接到球时，蓝军几乎取得了领先，但她的射门稍稍偏出了左侧门柱。西班牙队提供了真正的考验：组织良好，位置纪律严明，并努力阻止我们。因此，半场哨响时，切尔西以1-1领先，中场休息后还有更多工作要做。比赛重新开始后不久，斯乔克·努斯肯（Sjoeke Nusken）将球打入网内，但裁判迅速举起旗帜将其排除。当詹姆斯开出危险的角球时，布尔曼高高跃起，高过禁区内的所有球员，头球攻门，帮助我们在比赛中首次取得领先。但这种领先只维持了四分钟，马科斯禁区内右脚射门，比分再次打成平手。不过，切尔西还没有结束。当维克·卡普坦（Wieke Kaptein）在距离球门 20 码处为努斯肯（Nusken）传球时，这位德国国脚为首次亮相的梅尔文·马拉德（Melvine Malard）打出了完美的直塞球，让法国国脚绕过门将破门得分。有一种感觉皇家社会队很累，当卡彭特在底线发力时，她的后卫在关键时刻滑倒，让澳大利亚人将球拉回给冲上来的詹姆斯，后者在横梁下完成射门。切尔西现在处于优势地位，替补出场的滨野麻香距离传球只有几英寸之遥，这将给守门员带来一场严峻的考验，还有十场比赛。在第二回合中取得两球领先就已经足够了，但詹姆斯的进球几乎是复制品，这进一步扩大了我们的优势。卡彭特再次沿着通道前进，她的速度超过了盯防者，她将球传给了前里昂队友马拉德。 我们的新九号在首次亮相时就梅开二度，这是这位前锋的明确信号。 9 月 2 日星期三，我们带着三球缓冲进入圣塞巴斯蒂安的第二回合比赛。我们将前往西班牙，迎战女足冠军联赛预选赛的第二场比赛，对阵皇家社会队，然后于 9 月 5 日星期六在斯坦福桥主场迎战阿斯顿维拉，这是我们本赛季的第一场女足超级联赛交锋。您可以在这里购买那场激动人心的主场比赛的门票。切尔西：汉普顿、卡彭特、吉尔马（铜牌 64）、布尔曼、麦凯布、沃尔什、努斯肯、汤普森、詹姆斯（哈马诺 76）、巴尔的摩（卡普坦 55）、比弗-琼斯（马拉德 55）未上场替补：彭、斯宾塞、比约恩、德拉戈尼、波特、拉斯、萨维进球者：吉尔马 29、布尔曼54、马拉德 67、88、詹姆斯 74 黄牌：努斯肯 24' 皇家社会：阿鲁拉、卡米诺、阿帕里西奥 (Isasisasmendi 90)、弗洛伦蒂诺、维森特 (c)、坎波 (Laborde 76)、卡希诺瓦、费尔南德斯、阿罗拉·阿帕里西奥、马林 (Eizaguirre 76)、马科斯 未使用替补： Estensoro、Mendiburu、Eguiguren、Lezeta、Seelenfreund、Carlota Chacon、Soroa评分者：Marin 7、Marcos 58裁判：Silvia Gasperotti

news.title: Under-18 Premier League Cup report: Wolverhampton Wanderers 0-2 Chelsea

news.body_en: Chelsea Under-18s began our U18 Premier League Cup campaign with a 2-0 victory over Wolverhampton Wanderers, as goals from Andrew Pennie and Heze Grimwade secured the win at the Sir Jack Hayward Training Ground. The Blues pressed with purpose from the opening stages and Pennie provided an early breakthrough with a powerful right-footed finish. Wolves continued to threaten, but Chelsea defended well when called upon and goalkeeper Jake Murray produced an important second-half save. Substitute Grimwade then doubled our advantage with 14 minutes remaining to complete the scoring. Chelsea created the first opportunity after five minutes. Yunus Linton's pressing presented Pennie with a chance in front of goal, but Alfie Arnold made the save. The breakthrough followed shortly afterwards. Pennie charged into the penalty area before beating Arnold with a powerful right-footed effort from a tight angle. Linton was among those to test the Wolves goalkeeper, directing a left-footed attempt towards the centre of the goal in the 38th minute, but Arnold kept it out. The hosts threatened at the other end moments later. Emmanuel Ayinde applied the defensive pressure required to prevent the Wolves striker from going through one-on-one. Pennie had the final opportunity of the half, sending a firm right-footed effort from outside the penalty area narrowly wide of the right post. The Blues continued to threaten after the interval and Linton forced another save with a left-footed strike in the 58th minute. Dan Hogan made three changes on the hour, introducing Trey Faromo-Adebayo, Grimwade and Bilal Shah in place of Linton, Pennie and Jack Anderson. Gabriel Sambou and Diego Chinyowa followed shortly afterwards. Wolves then applied a quick spell of pressure and Murray was called into action in the 71st minute. Our goalkeeper produced an excellent save to deny a close-range effort and protect Chelsea's advantage. Grimwade saw a shot blocked after receiving a good pass into the box from Shah, but the substitute was not to be denied. A minute later, Grimwade found space at a tight angle inside the penalty area and produced a composed right-footed finish to double the Blues' lead. The result gives Chelsea three points from our opening U18 Premier League Cup fixture of the 2026/27 season, to join Manchester United on maximum points in Group F. Our Under-18s return to league action on Saturday 29 August, when we host Reading at Cobham Training Centre. The fixture kicks off at 11am and can be watched live with a CFC+ subscription. news.title: Alonso on a balancing act and team focus
news.title_zh: 阿隆索谈平衡行为和团队焦点
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso explained why it will be vital for him to find the right balance to his team to face Luton Town on Thursday evening. Chelsea’s Carabao Cup campaign kicks off in west London tomorrow night, when we host League One side Luton in Alonso’s first competitive match on home soil in the Stamford Bridge dugout. Ahead of the second round tie, our Spanish manager was asked if he is likely to rotate his starting XI for this knockout game. It comes hot on the heels of Monday’s 3-2 win at Fulham in our opening Premier League fixture of the season, with the league visit of Brighton & Hove Albion fast approaching on Sunday. Alonso insisted he won’t be taking our Carabao Cup opponents lightly, ensuring that any rotation retains the right balance and competitiveness in the Chelsea line-up, as he plots our progress across three domestic fronts this season. ‘This season, knowing that we have time for all the competitions, every cup is important, every game is important,’ insisted Xabi. ‘We want to have the best competitive team to face Luton, with all the respect that everything deserves. And Luton are going to be the first game in the Carabao Cup. ‘The main thing is the quality of the players, that they adjust and that we have balance with the players around them that makes sense and makes the team better. ‘That is always my main focus, that the team is better with the qualities and knowing the best qualities of each individual player.’ During his pre-match press conference ahead of the Carabao Cup second round meeting with Luton, Alonso was also asked if he offered any specific words for Robert Sanchez in the last couple of days. It is clear that it is the team’s performance which is foremost in the mind of manager and players. ‘No, normal conversations,’ our manager responded. ‘We have talked more about team things, what we did well, what we have to do better. It was more about understanding the context of the game. ‘Every game is going to be important because we are in this process where we need to develop things, we need to make adjustments and we are more team focused.’
news.body_zh: 哈比·阿隆索解释了为什么在周四晚上对阵卢顿镇时为球队找到适当的平衡对他来说至关重要。切尔西的卡拉宝杯比赛将于明天晚上在伦敦西部拉开帷幕，届时我们将在斯坦福桥教练席迎战联赛球队卢顿，这是阿隆索在主场的第一场正式比赛。在第二轮比赛之前，我们的西班牙主帅被问及是否有可能在这场淘汰赛中轮换首发阵容。周一我们在本赛季首场英超比赛中以 3-2 战胜富勒姆，紧接着周日布莱顿的联赛访问也即将到来。阿隆索坚称，他不会轻视我们的卡拉宝杯对手，确保任何轮换都能在切尔西阵容中保持适当的平衡和竞争力，同时他还规划了我们本赛季在三个国内战线上的进步。 “这个赛季，我们有时间参加所有比赛，每场杯赛都很重要，每场比赛都很重要，”哈维坚持说。 “我们希望拥有一支最具竞争力的球队来面对卢顿，并得到一切应有的尊重。卢顿将是卡拉宝杯的第一场比赛。 “最重要的是球员的素质，他们会进行调整，我们与他们周围的球员保持平衡，这有意义并使球队变得更好。 “这始终是我的主要关注点，球队的素质更好，并且了解每个球员的最佳素质。”在卡拉宝杯第二轮对阵卢顿的赛前新闻发布会上，阿隆索还被问到他在过去几天是否对罗伯特·桑切斯提出了任何具体的说法。显然，教练和球员最关心的是球队的表现。 “不，正常的对话，”我们的经理回答道。 “我们更多地谈论了团队的事情，我们做得好的地方，我们必须做得更好的地方。更多的是关于理解游戏的背景。 “每场比赛都将很重要，因为我们正处于这个过程中，我们需要开发东西，我们需要做出调整，我们更加注重团队。”

news.title: Xabi Alonso delivers the latest Chelsea team news ahead of Luton
news.title_zh: 哈比·阿隆索在卢顿之前发布了最新的切尔西队新闻
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso confirmed at his pre-match press conference that both Moises Caicedo and Marco Palestra will miss Thursday’s Carabao Cup clash with Luton Town. The duo were both absent against Fulham on opening day, a game that the Blues won 3-2, and Alonso has announced that they will again sit out on Thursday - but Caicedo could return for the weekend visit of his former side Brighton. Elsewhere, the Spaniard stated that goalkeeper Mike Penders has an opportunity to feature, while he also expects Enzo Fernandez to be in the squad. ‘Not for tomorrow, both won’t make it [against Luton],’ Alonso said of Caicedo and Palestra. ‘Let’s see, hopefully Moi could make it for the weekend, but we need to check a little bit more with Marco. ‘Otherwise everyone from Monday is okay, Cole [Palmer] is absolutely fine. ‘Penders is part of the squad, so he has an opportunity. We will decide and then I am giving the team tomorrow to the players, so I prefer to respect that they know first. ‘Enzo, yes we expect him to be involved. He is training really well, he’s a good professional, and he will be involved.’
news.body_zh: 哈比·阿隆索在赛前新闻发布会上证实，莫伊塞斯·凯塞多和马科·帕莱斯特拉都将缺席周四与卢顿镇的联赛杯比赛。两人都缺席了揭幕战对阵富勒姆的比赛，这场比赛蓝军以 3-2 获胜，阿隆索宣布他们将在周四再次缺席，但凯塞多可能会在周末对阵他的前东家布莱顿的比赛中回归。在其他地方，西班牙人表示门将迈克·彭德斯有机会出场，同时他也希望恩佐·费尔南德斯能够加入球队。 “明天不行，两人都不会（对阵卢顿），”阿隆索谈到凯塞多和帕莱斯特拉时说道。 “让我们看看，希望莫伊能够度过周末，但我们需要与马可进行更多检查。 “除此之外，从周一开始大家都还好，科尔（帕尔默）绝对没问题。 “彭德斯是球队的一员，所以他有机会。我们将做出决定，然后我将明天的球队交给球员，所以我更愿意尊重他们首先知道的事情。 “恩佐，是的，我们希望他参与其中。他训练得非常好，他是一名优秀的职业球员，他会参与其中。”

news.title: Chelsea vs Luton: Key statistics and facts
news.title_zh: 切尔西 vs 卢顿：关键统计数据和事实
news.body_en: Chelsea begin our Carabao Cup campaign at the second-round stage, with a tie against League One Luton Town. Here are all the facts and figures you need ahead of the Hatters' visit to Stamford Bridge. Chelsea meet Luton Town for the first time since December 2023. Chelsea and Luton have never met in the League Cup before. We have faced them five times in the FA Cup, winning four, while our only Full Members’ Cup meeting ended in defeat on penalties. 	The Blues have won our past five meetings with Luton, starting with the 1994 FA Cup semi-final at Wembley. We then beat the Hatters in the FA Cup in both 2021 and 2022, before completing a Premier League double over them in 2023/24.	Luton’s last win at Stamford Bridge was 3-1 in September 1986 in the old First Division. Kerry Dixon scored our goal in front of just over 13,000 fans. Joao Pedro’s opener against Fulham, timed at 31 seconds, was our quickest goal since October 2016, when Pedro scored against Manchester United at Stamford Bridge after 30 seconds. The Blues went on to win 4-0 on that occasion. This will be Chelsea’s third appearance in the League Cup second round in the past 30 years. The previous two both came at Stamford Bridge - a 3-2 win over Bristol Rovers in 2016 and a 2-1 victory against Wimbledon in 2023. Chelsea have advanced from 27 of our last 28 League Cup ties against teams from outside the top flight, including each of the last 19, since losing on penalties to Burnley in November 2008. Chelsea last went out in the League Cup second round in 1995/96, losing to Stoke City over two legs. After a goalless draw at the Victoria Ground, we were beaten 1-0 at Stamford Bridge. The last time Chelsea were eliminated from the competition by a lower-division side was in the fourth round in November 2008, when we lost 5-4 on penalties to Burnley after a 1-1 draw. Thursday’s game will be Chelsea’s 107th League Cup match at Stamford Bridge, having won 69 per cent of the previous 106 (five after a penalty shootout). Chelsea lost our most recent Carabao Cup home match, against Arsenal in last season’s semi-final first leg. Our previous defeat at Stamford Bridge in the competition came against Manchester United in 2019. If the aggregate scores are level after 90 minutes, the tie will be decided on penalties as there is no extra time in this competition until the semi-final stage. It has been nearly three years since our last penalty shootout, when we beat Newcastle United 4-2 in the League Cup quarter-final in December 2023. Last Saturday they drew 2-2 with Notts County at Kenilworth Road. They are third in League One after two rounds of games. The Hatters beat League Two side Gillingham 3-0 away in the Carabao Cup first round. Their scorers were Nahki Wells, Benny Benagr and Gideon Kodua. Luton ended last season with three straight wins and have won two and drawn one this term, extending their unbeaten run to 15 matches since their last defeat on 7 March. After their 2023/24 Premier League campaign, Luton suffered back-to-back relegations into League One, before missing out on the play-offs last season by just one point. The most recent occasion Luton were involved in a shootout was in December last year, when they lost 4-2 on penalties to Fleetwood in the FA Cup second round. Luton have been eliminated from eight of their past nine ties against Premier League opponents in the League Cup. The Hatters have progressed from three of their last four Carabao Cup second-round ties, but lost on penalties to Queens Park Rangers in their most recent appearance at this stage, in 2024/25. Former Blues academy players Kasey Palmer and George Saville play for Luton. Jack Wilshere has never managed a side against Chelsea. news.title: Axel Disasi completes Crystal Palace loan switch
news.title_zh: 阿克塞尔·迪萨西完成租借水晶宫
news.body_en: Chelsea defender Axel Disasi has joined Crystal Palace on loan for the 2026/27 season. The centre-back moved to Stamford Bridge from AS Monaco in August 2023 and has made more than 60 appearances in blue. The France international started our first eight matches in the victorious UEFA Conference League campaign in 2024/25, before finishing the season on loan at Aston Villa. Disasi then spent the second half of last season on loan at West Ham, starting 16 of their 17 matches in all competitions. Everyone at Chelsea wishes Axel well and looks forward to following his progress during his time with Crystal Palace.
news.body_zh: 切尔西后卫阿克塞尔·迪萨西于 2026/27 赛季租借加盟水晶宫。这位中后卫于 2023 年 8 月从摩纳哥转会至斯坦福桥，并已代表蓝色出场超过 60 场。这位法国国脚在2024/25赛季胜利的欧洲联盟联赛中首发了前八场比赛，然后租借到阿斯顿维拉结束了这个赛季。迪萨西上赛季后半段被租借到西汉姆联，在所有比赛的 17 场比赛中首发了 16 场。切尔西的每个人都祝愿阿克塞尔一切顺利，并期待着他在水晶宫期间的进步。

news.title: Chelsea’s fastest Premier League goals
news.title_zh: 切尔西最快的英超进球
news.body_en: Joao Pedro gave Chelsea an early lead inside the first minute at Fulham, adding his name to the list of the Blues’ fastest scorers in the Premier League. The Brazilian opened the scoring with just 31 seconds on the clock at Craven Cottage on Monday night, breaking clear from Cole Palmer’s flick to make a flying start to the 2026/27 campaign and set us on our way to a 3-2 victory. It was officially the earliest goal ever on the Premier League’s opening weekend, but only good enough to come sixth on the all-time list of Chelsea’s fastest goalscorers in that competition. Here are the five players who found the net quicker for the Blues in the Premier League… Chelsea blew Man Utd away on Jose Mourinho’s return to Stamford Bridge with the Red Devils. It was Pedro who got the ball rolling on the thrashing when the visiting defenders dawdled in a moment of miscommunication. There was no such hesitancy from our Spanish forward, who took full advantage to round the keeper and slot in. It wasn’t to be Chelsea’s day, as Arsenal came back to take the win at Stamford Bridge and go seven points clear at the top of the Premier League table, but we had got off to the best possible start. That came when Gudjohnsen showed his instincts in the box to control Geremi’s cross brilliantly and fire the opening goal past the keeper. Manchester United’s run of 29 games without defeat came to an emphatic end at Stamford Bridge, as Chelsea turned on the style. The Blues went on the attack right from kick-off, giving Dan Petrescu the chance to cross. When United goalkeeper Massimo Taibi came to collect but collided with one of his defenders, Poyet gratefully headed into the empty net. The Blues were heavy favourites against newly-promoted Nottingham Forest when we met at the Bridge early in the 1998/99 campaign, despite the visitors' decent start to the season. We underlined that status early on, though, with a goal all of Zola’s own making. It was his cross into the box from a throw-in on the left which created the chance. When Forest failed to clear their lines, the Italian was there following in on his own cross to place a first-time finish into the bottom corner. Chelsea had lost two home games in a row when Leicester came to Stamford Bridge looking to be the next visiting side to inflict pain on the Blues. This time we raced into an early, and unassailable, lead. An early foul gifted us a free-kick on the halfway line and Dennis Wise took the chance to run clear into space. He then picked out a teasing angled cross to the back post, where Spencer floated in the air to meet it and head down into the net.
news.body_zh: 若奥·佩德罗在对阵富勒姆的比赛中开场第一分钟就帮助切尔西取得领先，他也因此被列入了英超联赛中蓝军最快得分手的名单中。周一晚上，这位巴西人在克雷文小屋比赛还剩 31 秒时就率先破门，从科尔·帕尔默 (Cole Palmer) 的射门中突破，为 2026/27 赛季开局，帮助我们以 3-2 取得胜利。这正式是英超联赛揭幕周末历史上最早的进球，但仅够在切尔西队史上最快进球者名单上排名第六。以下是在英超联赛中为蓝军更快进球的五名球员……穆里尼奥带领红魔重返斯坦福桥后，切尔西击败了曼联。当客队后卫在沟通不畅时磨蹭时，是佩德罗在殴打中将球滚动。我们的西班牙前锋没有如此犹豫，他充分利用了绕过门将的机会并射门。这不是切尔西的一天，阿森纳在斯坦福桥拿下胜利，在英超联赛积分榜上领先七分，但我们已经取得了最好的开局。当古德约翰森在禁区内展现出他的直觉时，他出色地控制了格雷米的传中，并射出了门将的进球。曼联的 29 场不败纪录在斯坦福桥终结，切尔西开启了这种风格。蓝军一开球就发起进攻，给了丹·佩特雷斯库传中的机会。当曼联门将马西莫·泰比前来接球但与一名后卫相撞时，波耶特感激地头球攻入空门。 1998/99赛季初期，当我们在蓝桥交锋时，蓝军是对阵升班马诺丁汉森林队的热门球队，尽管客队本赛季开局不错。不过，我们很早就强调了这一地位，目标完全是佐拉自己创造的。正是他从左侧掷界外球传入禁区，创造了机会。当森林队未能清除对方防线时，意大利人接应自己的传中，首次将球射入底角。当莱斯特城来到斯坦福桥时，切尔西已经连续输掉了两场主场比赛，他们希望成为下一个给蓝军带来痛苦的客队。这次我们一早就取得了无可争议的领先优势。早些时候的一次犯规让我们在中场线获得了一个任意球，丹尼斯·怀斯抓住机会跑向空位。然后他挑出一记挑衅性的斜传球到后门柱，斯宾塞漂浮在空中接球，头球入网。

news.title: Chelsea and FPT extend strategic partnership into 2026/27 season
news.title_zh: 切尔西与 FPT 将战略合作伙伴关系延续至 2026/27 赛季
news.body_en: Chelsea Football Club and Global Technology Services provider FPT Corporation today announce the extension of our existing partnership for the 2026/27 season. Since first joining forces in 2025, Chelsea and FPT have worked closely together to transform the club’s digital capabilities and enhance the club’s fan engagement to bring Chelsea fans across the world closer to club. With FPT’s market-leading technology solutions and expertise, together Chelsea and FPT have delivered on a number of key projects. Megastore Express – a new mobile-first click-and-collect system – was unveiled in January and streamlines the retail experience for fans on matchdays. A new Official Supporters Club platform was also launched earlier this year and has become the new home for fans from across the world to build supporter groups, join in club activities and be a part of the Chelsea community. These transformative initiatives are a marker of our shared vision to enhance how the club engages with our ever-growing global fan base, enriching the fan experience at Stamford Bridge and beyond. The extension of this partnership is a celebration of the significant progress FPT and Chelsea have made together and marks a renewed commitment to continue the club’s digital transformation journey. Oli Boden, partnership sales director at Chelsea FC, said: 'At Chelsea we are continually focused on innovating and unlocking the opportunities technology and AI-based solutions present to grow our digital presence and bring our fans closer to the club. ‘Together we have delivered significant projects that have transformed the way in which fans can engage with the club. As we embark on the next stage of our partnership with FPT, we reaffirm our commitment to accelerating innovation and enriching the fan experience for our supporters at home and abroad.’‘This partnership reaffirms the qualities that Chelsea FC saw in FPT from the beginning: the ability to deliver at speed and scale, a co-creation mindset, and an AI-driven approach to innovation,’ said Mark Scrivens, CEO of FPT in the United Kingdom. ‘Our teams will continue working side by side to turn ambitious concepts into live, fan-focused solutions, which is a testament to the talent, agility, and engineering excellence of our people, and demonstrates how FPT helps organisations accelerate transformation while remaining focused on delivering measurable outcomes.’
news.body_zh: 切尔西足球俱乐部和全球技术服务提供商 FPT Corporation 今天宣布将我们现有的合作伙伴关系延长至 2026/27 赛季。自 2025 年首次联手以来，切尔西和 FPT 一直密切合作，以转变俱乐部的数字能力并提高俱乐部的球迷参与度，从而拉近世界各地的切尔西球迷与俱乐部的距离。凭借 FPT 市场领先的技术解决方案和专业知识，Chelsea 和 FPT 共同交付了许多关键项目。 Megastore Express——一种新的移动优先点击取货系统——于一月份推出，简化了球迷在比赛日的零售体验。今年早些时候还推出了新的官方支持者俱乐部平台，该平台已成为来自世界各地的球迷建立支持者团体、参加俱乐部活动并成为切尔西社区一部分的新家。这些变革性举措标志着我们共同的愿景，即加强俱乐部与不断增长的全球球迷群体的互动，丰富斯坦福桥及其他地区的球迷体验。此次合作伙伴关系的延长是对 FPT 和切尔西共同取得的重大进展的庆祝，并标志着俱乐部继续数字化转型之旅的新承诺。切尔西足球俱乐部合作伙伴销售总监奥利·博登 (Oli Boden) 表示：“在切尔西，我们不断致力于创新和释放技术和基于人工智能的解决方案所带来的机会，以扩大我们的数字化影响力，拉近我们的球迷与俱乐部的距离。” “我们共同完成了一些重大项目，改变了球迷与俱乐部互动的方式。当我们开始与 FPT 的下一阶段合作时，我们重申致力于加速创新并丰富国内外球迷的体验。”英国 FPT 首席执行官 Mark Scrivens 表示，“此次合作重申了切尔西足球俱乐部从一开始就在 FPT 中看到的品质：快速和大规模交付的能力、共同创造的思维方式以及人工智能驱动的创新方法。” “我们的团队将继续并肩工作，将雄心勃勃的概念转化为以粉丝为中心的实时解决方案，这证明了我们员工的才华、敏捷性和卓越的工程能力，并展示了 FPT 如何帮助组织加速转型，同时保持专注于交付可衡量的成果。”

news.body_en: Chelsea will discover our potential Carabao Cup third-round opponents on Wednesday evening, ahead of our involvement in the competition beginning against Luton Town the following day. The Blues begin this season's Carabao Cup campaign in the second round, when we host the Hatters at Stamford Bridge on Thursday night, with kick-off at 7.30pm. Before we take to the pitch for that game, the opponents awaiting the winner in the next round will already be known... The draw for the third round will take place on Wednesday 26 August, following the conclusion of Preston North End's second-round match against Everton. The draw will be broadcast live on Sky Sports in the UK. We will bring you news of the draw on the Chelsea Official App and website as soon as it is known. The ball numbers for the Carabao Cup third-round draw will be announced on Wednesday 26 August. Every team that progresses from the northern and southern section of the draw remain potential opponents for the third round. The nine Premier League teams competing in Europe will also enter the competition at the third-round stage. There is no north-south split to the draw from the third round on. The only restrictions to the draw are the eight teams competing in the UEFA Champions League and UEFA Europa League being seeded, meaning they cannot face each other, but are not guaranteed a home or away game. That leaves Chelsea with these possible Carabao Cup opponents in the third round, ahead of Wednesday's matches: ArsenalAston VillaBarnsleyBrentfordSheffield UnitedLincoln CityBournemouthBradford City/BurnleyBrighton & Hove AlbionNorwich CityMillwallCrystal PalaceMiddlesbroughFleetwood TownFulham/WimbledonIpswich TownLiverpoolManchester CityManchester UnitedNewcastle United/West Bromwich AlbionLeeds UnitedCoventry CityPreston North End/EvertonWolverhampton WanderersWest Ham UnitedReadingHull CitySunderlandTottenham Hotspur/Charlton AthleticLeyton OrientPeterborough United Third-round ties will be split across two midweek slots to accommodate European fixture commitments, with games played on the weeks beginning 7 September and 14 September.

news.title: PGA South League report: London City Under-21s 0-8 Chelsea Women’s Under-18s
news.title_zh: PGA 南部联赛报告：伦敦城 21 岁以下青年队 0-8 切尔西女子 18 岁以下青年队
news.body_en: Chelsea Women’s Under-18s began their Professional Game Academy South League campaign in impressive fashion, securing an 8-0 victory away at London City Lionesses Under-21s on Wednesday evening. Chelsea Women's Under-18s, who play in the PGA Under-21 Women's League, were ahead inside seven minutes on Wednesday through Stevie Sinclair and established a two-goal advantage before the interval thanks to Maisie Brickell's strike. After the break, Chelsea added six more goals, with Chelsea N'Drin, Sinclair and Brickell all ending the match with two goals, while Jahyma Putman and Tess Finn also added their names to the scoresheet. Chelsea dominated possession throughout and combined attacking quality with defensive discipline to ensure they opened the new league season with both three points and a clean sheet. Chelsea made a positive start and moved in front after seven minutes. Victoria Rudz's clipped pass into the wide channel allowed Brickell to advance down the flank and deliver a cross into the box. Sinclair arrived from midfield and fired home from the edge of the area to give the Blues an early lead. The second goal arrived after 17 minutes and again involved Rudz and Brickell. Spotting space beyond the London City back line, Rudz played forward into the right channel, where Brickell drove towards goal before cutting across her defender and finishing at the near post. Chelsea continued to control possession and territory for the remainder of the first half, limiting opportunities for the hosts while taking a deserved two-goal advantage into the interval. A triple substitution at the break helped maintain Chelsea's momentum and a third goal arrived six minutes into the second half. After Putman switched play to Zoe Ciccardini, the defender found Sinclair's run in behind. The goalkeeper showed bravery to deny Sinclair's initial effort, but N'Drin reacted quickest to convert the rebound. Chelsea continued to press aggressively and nearly extended the lead further when N'Drin was brought down in the penalty area after a high regain. Sinclair's resulting penalty was saved, but the Blues were adding to the scoresheet once again soon after. The fourth goal arrived on 76 minutes when combinations around the edge of the box by Finn and N’Drin helped create space for Sinclair, who took a touch beyond the last defender before finishing confidently. A minute later Chelsea struck again. Finn recovered possession high up the pitch and switched play to Putman, who advanced towards goal before spinning past the goalkeeper and calmly finishing into an empty net. Finn then added her own name to the scoresheet on 86 minutes. After some quick combinations the ball was worked wide to Putman at left wing, she showed positive 1v1 play to get to the byline to pull the ball back to the edge of the box for the arriving Finn, who’s placed shot to the goalkeeper’s right added another. Three minutes later, N’Drin and Gregory helped win possession high up the pitch and the latter played into Brickell on the edge of the box. She turned and placed a composed finish across goal for Chelsea's seventh. There was still time for one more. Deep into added time, Sinclair dropped low to combine with Ciccardini, who was able to find Storey inside the pitch, with good vision and quick play. Storey played forward through the defensive line of London City Lionesses to find Brickell in the wide area. After some more positive play, Brickell delivered a lofted cross into the box which was met by N’Drin in the air to score the final goal. The result means Chelsea Women Under-18s sit top of the Professional Game Academy South League table thanks to their eight-goal winning margin. Chelsea's next fixture sees us travel to face Wycombe Wanderers Women in the senior Women's National League Cup on Thursday. The Blues then return to Professional Game Academy South League action on Sunday 30 August when Crystal Palace visit. Chelsea Women Under-18s (4-3-3): Victoria Rudz; Elise Christian, Sophie Leach, Zoe Ciccardini, Maisie Brickell; Belle Sullivan © (Sadie Gregory 70’), Stevie Sinclair, Keira Johnson (Tess Finn 45’); Rebekah Pierce (Jahyma Putman 45’), Carla Gardiner (Chelsea N’Drin 45’), Aysia Matabaro (Gabi Storey 45’) Scorers: Sinclair 7, 76; Brickell 17, 89; N'Drin 51, 90+5; Putman 77; Finn 86
news.body_zh: 切尔西女子 18 岁以下队以令人印象深刻的方式开始了职业比赛学院南联赛的征程，周三晚客场以 8-0 战胜伦敦城狮队 21 岁以下队。参加 PGA 21 岁以下女子联赛的切尔西 18 岁以下女子队在周三的七分钟内就通过史蒂夫·辛克莱 (Stevie Sinclair) 领先，并在中场休息前凭借麦茜·布里克尔 (Maisie Brickell) 的进球确立了两球优势。中场休息后，切尔西又进了六个进球，恩德林、辛克莱和布里克尔均以两球结束了比赛，而贾希玛·普特曼和泰斯·芬恩也将自己的名字写入了进球表。切尔西自始至终都掌控着控球权，并将进攻质量与防守纪律相结合，确保他们以三分和不失球的成绩开启新赛季。切尔西开局积极，七分钟后就取得领先。维多利亚·鲁兹（Victoria Rudz）的短传球进入宽阔的通道，使布里克尔（Brickell）能够沿着侧翼推进并将传中球送入禁区。辛克莱从中场赶来，在禁区边缘射门，让蓝军早早取得领先。第 17 分钟后，鲁兹和布里克尔再次进球。鲁兹发现了伦敦城队后防线之外的空间，向前冲入右路，布里克尔带球冲向球门，然后越过防守球员，射入近门柱。切尔西在上半场余下的时间里继续控制着控球权和地盘，限制了主队的机会，同时在中场休息时取得了当之无愧的两球优势。中场休息时的三次换人帮助切尔西保持了势头，下半场六分钟后第三个进球到来。在普特曼将比赛换给佐伊·西卡迪尼后，这名后卫发现辛克莱尔在后面跑动。门将表现出勇敢，挡住了辛克莱最初的射门，但恩德林反应最快，将篮板球转化为球。切尔西继续积极施压，恩德林在禁区内高位扳平后被放倒，险些扩大领先优势。辛克莱的点球被扑出，但蓝军很快就再次进球。第四个进球出现在第 76 分钟，芬恩和恩德林在禁区边缘的配合为辛克莱创造了空间，辛克莱在最后一名后卫身后触球，然后自信地射门。一分钟后，切尔西再次破门。芬恩在高位夺回控球权，并将比赛交给普特曼，普特曼冲向球门，然后转身越过了门将，冷静地射入空门。第 86 分钟，芬恩将自己的名字添加到了记分表上。经过一些快速组合后，球传给了左翼的普特曼，她表现出了积极的一对一表现，到达边线，将球拉回禁区边缘，交给到达的芬恩，芬恩在守门员右侧射门又进一球。三分钟后，恩德林和格雷戈里在高位帮助赢得控球权，格雷戈里在禁区边缘传球给布里克尔。她转身冷静地射门，为切尔西打入第七球。还有时间再来一件事。补时阶段，辛克莱尔低位与西卡迪尼配合，西卡迪尼凭借良好的视野和快速的进攻找到了内线的斯托里。斯托里向前突破伦敦城母狮队的防线，在边路找到布里克尔。经过一些积极的比赛后，布里克尔将一记高高传中送入禁区，恩德林在空中接应，打进了最后一球。这一结果意味着切尔西 18 岁以下女子队凭借 8 球的优势位居职业比赛学院南联赛积分榜榜首。切尔西的下一场比赛将于周四在高级女子国家联赛杯中迎战韦科姆流浪者女足。随后，蓝军将在 8 月 30 日星期日重返职业比赛学院南联赛，届时水晶宫将作客。切尔西 18 岁以下女子队 (4-3-3)：维多利亚·鲁兹；埃莉斯·克里斯蒂安、索菲·利奇、佐伊·西卡迪尼、麦茜·布里克尔； Belle Sullivan © (Sadie Gregory 70’)、Stevie Sinclair、Keira Johnson (Tess Finn 45’)；丽贝卡·皮尔斯 (Jahyma Putman 45’)、卡拉·加德纳 (Chelsea N’Drin 45’)、艾西亚·马塔巴罗 (Gabi Storey 45’) 进球者：辛克莱 7、76；布里克尔 17, 89;恩德林 51, 90+5;普特曼77；芬恩86

news.title: Premier League ticket news: Hull at home - ticket application window closing

news.body_en: Ticket sales information has been released for our second home Premier League match of the season. The Blues host Hull City at Stamford Bridge on Saturday 12 September with a 3pm kick-off. Supporters intending to travel to or from this game using the London Underground are advised that planned engineering works may affect your journey. There will be no District Line service between Tower Hill and Edgware Road to Wimbledon, Kensington (Olympia), Richmond and Ealing Broadway stations. This means Fulham Broadway Station will be closed all day and there will be no District Line trains running to any nearby stations on that branch of the tube network. There is also no Circle Line from Edgware Road to Aldgate (via Victoria). Home tickets for members for men’s team matches are now allocated through a new application process. For each home match, eligible members have a designated application window during which they can apply for tickets. Applications can be made individually or as a group, provided all members of the group are eligible to apply during that window. Tickets will be allocated one per person with a maximum of four per application. Ticket application window opens – Friday 21 August 12pm Ticket application window closes – Wednesday 26 August 12pm The Ticket application window will be open for True Blue+, True Blue, CFC Blue, and Junior Blue members. As part of the verification process, a pre-authorisation charge £0.01 will be applied to validate your payment card. No money will be taken at this stage, and the hold will be removed by your provider. Tickets for this match are priced at Category B. Please click here for match ticket prices Tickets will appear on the Chelsea Official App prior to the event. Eligible members can submit their application through the ticketing portal at any time during the window, supporters must ensure they are logged in to successfully apply. Applying earlier does not increase the likelihood of success, giving supporters greater flexibility to apply at a time that suits them. As part of the new ticket sales process, members who are eligible for concession-rate tickets are automatically assigned their price class. To ensure you are receiving the correct ticket, please take the time to check the date of birth on your account is accurate. You will only be allocated tickets in your selected areas unless you choose to be considered for other available options. If you only wish to be entered for tickets in one area of the stadium, please leave the second option blank. Please read the ticket application information carefully before submitting your application. Successful and unsuccessful applications will be notified by email within four working days of the ticket application window closing date. Successful applications will be charged to their payment card approximately at this time. Supporters are not able to use account credit for ticket application window purchases. Tickets are for Chelsea supporters only. All persons under the age of 16 will be required to attend with and sit next to, a person aged 18 years of age or over. Members and season ticket holders can purchase Westview tickets for Premier League home games via the Chelsea FC Official Ticketing Portal. A maximum of four tickets can be bought per person, and only the ticket purchaser is required to be a member or season ticket holder. You are not required to be a member or season ticket holder to purchase non-Westview Club Chelsea packages. Club Chelsea tickets are non-refundable unless the match is cancelled, postponed, or moved more than 48 hours either side of the scheduled fixture date. All Club Chelsea ticket purchases are subject to Club Chelsea terms and conditions. For any further Westview enquiries, please email clubchelsea@chelseafc.com. Loyalty points will now only be awarded for attendance at men’s first-team home matches and no longer accrued for purchasing tickets. Points will be added to eligible accounts following each game, provided the ticket has been scanned at the turnstile. This means that supporters purchasing tickets on the ticket exchange, or receiving tickets via ticket forwarding, will now receive loyalty points for attending matches. Supporters will receive three loyalty points for attending this match. Points will be applied after the fixture has been played. Members can still purchase general admission tickets if available in line with the General Admission Policy. Supporters who require accessible tickets can apply through the accessible ticket application window. Timings are below: Accessible ticket application window opens - Friday 21 August 12pm Accessible ticket application window closes – Wednesday 26 August 12pm Supporters, if they are able to do so, can call our Access Team on 0371 811 2012 or 0044 207 915 1950 (international callers) for any questions or if they need further information. Personal assistant tickets can be submitted during this ticket application window. Supporters can apply for car parking by clicking here from Friday 28 August You are required to display your Blue Badge while parked at Stamford Bridge. In addition to season ticket holders, True Blue+, True Blue and CFC Blue members now have the option to list tickets on the ticket exchange if they are unable to attend a home match. Supporters can access the ticket exchange through the Official Ticketing Portal. The sales information on the Buy Tickets page will be updated once the ticket exchange is open. The ticket exchange will close three hours before kick-off, unless stated otherwise. Those unsuccessful in the ticket application window will have a ticket exchange priority window. Once open, season ticket holders and members can send and receive tickets up until three hours before kick-off. Please note that those who have forwarded their ticket will not be able to list their ticket on the ticket exchange. Click for ticket forwarding FAQs Match and ticket application window dates are subject to change. All ticket sales are subject to availability. Please check the website for the latest information.

news.title: EFL Trophy: Bristol Rovers 2-2 Cobham Next Gen (2-4 on pens)
news.title_zh: EFL奖杯：布里斯托尔流浪者队2-2科巴姆下一代（笔杆2-4）
news.body_en: Cobham Next Gen showed real heart as we came from two goals down to beat Bristol Rovers on penalties in our opening EFL Trophy fixture. The hosts led at the interval through Mees Rijks and extended their advantage via Joe Quigley shortly before the hour mark, despite the Blues enjoying most of the possession. Sol Gordon then created Harrison Bettoni’s 71st-minute goal before Chizaram Ezenwata drew us level in the closing stages. Freddy Bernal had kept Chelsea in the contest with several important saves and denied Jack Sparkes during the shoot-out, before Justin Osagie scored the decisive spot-kick to help us secure two points and go top in Southern Group C. Gordon had the first sight of goal after eight minutes, letting fly from the right side of the penalty area but sending his effort wide. Bernal produced a couple of important early saves to keep the contest close, but Bristol Rovers opened the scoring in the 22nd minute. Ryan de Havilland played the ball forward to Jack Aitchison, whose pass across goal was converted by Rijks. Chelsea had an opportunity to respond soon afterwards when Gordon won possession from Sparkes and found Ezenwata, but the forward was unable to take the chance. Harry Hudson made a double change in the 56th minute, introducing Lewi Richards and Mahdi Nicoll-Jazuli in place of Calvin Diakite and Harrison McMahon. Two minutes later, a cross the Blues were unable to clear reached Quigley at the far post and the striker finished to double the hosts’ advantage. Chelsea, who saw Andrew Pennie replace Jashayde Greenwood shortly after the hour mark, reduced the deficit in the 71st minute. Gordon beat Sparkes and drove to the byline before cutting the ball back for Bettoni, who finished first time. Bettoni found space again soon afterwards and went close to an equaliser. That second goal arrived in the 82nd minute. Nicoll-Jazuli’s neat spin created the opening and Ezenwata found the corner to bring the Blues level. Chelsea went in search of the winner and Pennie struck the side-netting in the second minute of stoppage time but the contest went to penalties. Ezenwata and Bettoni converted spot-kicks to help the Blues go 2-1 ahead, after Bernal saved from Sparkes. Richards then scored to make it 3-2 in the shootout and when Richard Smallwood failed to convert, it left Osagie to calmly seal a 4-2 shoot-out victory. Cobham Next Gen begin our EFL Trophy campaign with two points, earning one for the draw after 90 minutes and securing the bonus point through our shoot-out success. news.title: Three Blues named in PFA WSL Team of the Year for 2025/26
news.title_zh: 三支蓝军入选 PFA WSL 2025/26 年度最佳阵容
news.body_en: Three Chelsea players have been named in the PFA Women's Super League Team of the Year for the 2025/26 campaign, which was revealed at an awards ceremony at Manchester Opera House this evening. With the Blues preparing for tomorrow evening's UEFA Champions League qualifying round first leg against Real Sociedad – which can be viewed live on the Chelsea Official App and website – neither Sonia Bompastor nor her players attended the event. Yet that did not stop the performances of a trio of our players last season from being recognised by their fellow professionals. Hannah Hampton secured the goalkeeper spot in the Team of the Year, having kept eight clean sheets in 18 league appearances during the previous campaign. The PFA WSL Team of the Year in association with Care Fertility 🏆Voted for by the players. pic.twitter.com/94iUFmy5wA Fellow Blue and England international Lauren James was also handed a place in the side, having been voted by fans as our Player of the Season last year. Our No.10 scored several sublime goals last term, netting five times in 14 domestic games, and also went past the 100-appearance marker in blue. The third and final place in the WSL Team of the Year for a Chelsea player was Ellie Carpenter, who impressed throughout her maiden campaign in the English game. The Australian international made 19 appearances in the top flight last term, scoring twice and providing two assists. Several Blues received nominations for awards prior to Tuesday's ceremony. James was shortlisted for the PFA WSL Player of the Year honour, which went to Manchester City's Bunny Shaw, while Veerle Buurman and Alyssa Thompson were up for the PFA WSL Young Player of the Year. Be there to welcome our award-winners to our new home at Stamford Bridge when we take on Aston Villa in our first Women's Super League match of the season on 5 September at 12.35pm!
news.body_zh: 三名切尔西球员被评为 2025/26 赛季 PFA 女超联赛年度最佳阵容，这一奖项于今晚在曼彻斯特歌剧院举行的颁奖典礼上揭晓。蓝军正在为明天晚上对阵皇家社会的欧洲冠军联赛预选赛第一回合做准备——可以在切尔西官方应用程序和网站上现场观看比赛——索尼娅·邦帕斯托和她的球员都没有出席这一活动。然而，这并没有阻止我们三名球员上赛季的表现得到他们的职业同行的认可。汉娜·汉普顿 (Hannah Hampton) 在上赛季 18 场联赛中保持 8 场不失球，确保了年度最佳阵容的门将席位。 PFA WSL 年度最佳团队与 Care Fertility 🏆由球员投票选出。 pic.twitter.com/94iUFmy5wA 蓝队同胞、英格兰国脚劳伦·詹姆斯（Lauren James）也获得了球队的一席之地，去年他被球迷票选为我们的赛季最佳球员。我们的10号上赛季打进了几个精彩的进球，在14场国内比赛中攻入5球，并且还突破了代表蓝色出场的100场大关。切尔西球员埃莉·卡彭特 (Ellie Carpenter) 在 WSL 年度最佳阵容中排名第三，也是最后一位，她在英格兰比赛中的处女秀给人留下了深刻的印象。这位澳大利亚国脚上赛季在顶级联赛中出场19次，打进2球并助攻2次。在周二的颁奖典礼之前，一些蓝调乐队获得了奖项提名。詹姆斯入围 PFA WSL 年度最佳球员奖，该奖项颁给了曼城队的 Bunny Shaw，而维尔勒·布尔曼 (Veerle Buurman) 和阿丽莎·汤普森 (Alyssa Thompson) 则角逐 PFA WSL 年度最佳年轻球员。 9 月 5 日中午 12 点 35 分，我们将在斯坦福桥的新家迎接我们的获奖者，届时我们将在本赛季首场女子超级联赛比赛中迎战阿斯顿维拉！

news.title: Key talking points from Bompastor and Bronze ahead of Real Sociedad
news.title_zh: 皇家社会之前邦帕斯托和青铜的关键谈话要点
news.body_en: Sonia Bompastor and Lucy Bronze faced the media at Cobham this afternoon ahead of our Women's Champions League qualifier clash against Real Sociedad on Wednesday night. The Blues are looking to gain an advantage in the first leg at home in our maiden match at the Cherry Red Records Stadium, before heading to Spain for the return leg on 2 September. Tickets are still available for Wednesday's game, and you can purchase them here. Alongside the latest injury news provided by Bompastor, here is a rundown of the other major talking points from today's press conference... Sonia Bompastor: It will be a strong test. Real Sociedad finished third in the Liga F. They are a Spanish team, so they have a really strong philosophy in possession, but they have a lot of quality out of possession as well. We know everything about them now, and we prepared for the game well. But the game tomorrow will also be about us, and I'm confident with the quality we have shown during pre-season. Lucy Bronze: I remember playing against Real Sociedad in Liga F when I was at Barcelona, and they were always a good team. They always played good football. We had good results against them, but I always remember them being a really good team, something that me and Keira (Walsh) both spoke about recently. I actually watched the game last year when they were playing against Barca. They defended really well, which isn't the easiest thing to do against Barca when they were continually attacking. SB: Pre-season has been really good. We have worked really hard with a lot of intensity in training sessions. We travelled all over the world, and it was a really good opportunity for the squad to be together and for us to get to know each other better. Since we came back, we also recovered really well from the travel, but we got back to business, and I think we are in a really good place for the game tomorrow. LB: We've got a lot of young, talented players at Chelsea, a lot of eager players who are keen to learn and to listen. Sometimes they get things wrong, but they try really hard, and it's exciting to be part of the club and to see so many players grow, develop and improve every day. I think that's the exciting part of this team this year: the youth and the exuberance we will have on the pitch. LB: I think it's fun. We like playing against teams from different countries. The league phase last year was different, and I guess this is just another difference, but we're very much focused on this game. We know it's very important for us to win tomorrow, especially playing at home. We don't take anything for granted. We know what a good team they are. I think having more games this year is exciting for us as Chelsea, and being in a different position just allows you to adapt and learn new things about the team. LB: People forget how much spotlight was put on her from a very young age. But I think in the team at Chelsea, you can see she feels comfortable. She's grown as a player. She's grown as a person. You can see that she's grown so many connections with all of the team. We all know that when LJ is flowing, there's nobody in the world that can stop her. So it's nice to see that she's growing a lot. SB: As a coach, I'm someone who really cares about the players, but as a human, I also care about the humans and the person. So I think in this environment, I always try my best to encourage the players to be themselves and to express themselves. It's okay for us to be vulnerable sometimes. We spend so much time together, so I'm happy with what Lucy said in terms of allowing people to be themselves, in terms of vulnerability, but also when they are showing confidence, it's something good. LB: Pre-season has gone so well. The new signings are fitting in really well too. It just feels like we're on a fresh start. We have kind of put a line in the sand from last season, and moving forward to be even bigger and better than Chelsea's ever been. Be there to welcome CFCW to our new home at Stamford Bridge when we take on Aston Villa in our first Women's Super League match of the season on 5 September at 12.35pm!
news.body_zh: 今天下午，索尼娅·邦帕斯托和露西·青铜在科巴姆接受了媒体采访，准备周三晚上与皇家社会队进行女子冠军联赛预选赛。蓝军希望在樱桃红唱片体育场举行的首回合主场比赛中获得优势，然后于 9 月 2 日前往西班牙进行第二回合比赛。周三比赛的门票仍然有售，您可以在这里购买。除了 Bompastor 提供的最新伤病消息外，这里还概述了今天新闻发布会上的其他主要话题…… Sonia Bompastor：这将是一次强有力的考验。皇家社会队在西甲联赛中排名第三。他们是一支西班牙球队，因此他们在控球方面拥有很强的理念，但他们在控球方面也有很多实力。我们现在已经了解了他们的一切，并且我们为比赛做好了充分的准备。但明天的比赛也将是我们的比赛，我对我们在季前赛中表现出的实力充满信心。露西·布朗兹：我记得当我在巴塞罗那时，在联赛中对阵皇家社会队，他们一直是一支优秀的球队。他们总是踢出漂亮的足球。我们在对阵他们的比赛中取得了不错的成绩，但我一直记得他们是一支非常优秀的球队，这是我和凯拉（沃尔什）最近都谈到的。事实上，我去年就看过他们对阵巴萨的比赛。他们的防守非常好，当巴萨不断进攻时，这并不是最容易做到的事情。 SB：季前赛真的很棒。我们在训练中非常努力，强度很大。我们走遍了世界各地，这对球队来说是一个很好的机会，让我们能够更好地了解彼此。自从我们回来后，我们也从旅行中恢复得很好，但我们又回到了正事，我认为我们对于明天的比赛处于一个非常好的状态。 LB：我们切尔西有很多年轻、有才华的球员，很多渴望学习和倾听的球员。有时他们会犯错，但他们真的很努力，成为俱乐部的一员并看到这么多球员每天都在成长、发展和提高，这真是令人兴奋。我认为这就是今年这支球队令人兴奋的部分：我们在球场上将充满青春和活力。 LB：我觉得这很有趣。我们喜欢与来自不同国家的球队比赛。去年的联赛阶段有所不同，我想这只是另一个不同，但我们非常关注这场比赛。我们知道明天的胜利对我们来说非常重要，尤其是在主场比赛。我们不认为任何事情是理所当然的。我们知道他们是一支多么优秀的团队。我认为今年有更多的比赛对我们切尔西来说是令人兴奋的，处于不同的位置只会让你适应和了解球队的新事物。 LB：人们忘记了她从很小的时候起就受到了多少关注。但我认为在切尔西的球队中，你可以看到她感觉很舒服。作为一名球员，她已经成长了。她作为一个人已经成长了。您可以看到她与整个团队建立了如此多的联系。我们都知道，当LJ流动时，世界上没有人可以阻止她。所以很高兴看到她成长了很多。 SB：作为一名教练，我是一个真正关心球员的人，但作为一个人，我也关心人类和人。所以我觉得在这样的环境下，我总是尽力鼓励选手们做自己，表达自己。有时我们感到脆弱是没关系的。我们花了很多时间在一起，所以我很高兴露西所说的，让人们做自己，在脆弱方面，而且当他们表现出自信时，这是一件好事。 LB：季前赛进展顺利。新签约的球员也非常适合。感觉就像我们有了一个新的开始。从上个赛季开始，我们已经划定了界限，并继续前进，变得比切尔西以往任何时候都更大、更好。 9 月 5 日中午 12 点 35 分，我们将在本赛季首场女子超级联赛对阵阿斯顿维拉的比赛中欢迎 CFCW 来到我们位于斯坦福桥的新家！

news.title: Analysis: How POTM Cole Palmer inspired Blues to victory
news.title_zh: 分析：POTM 科尔·帕尔默如何激励蓝军取得胜利
news.body_en: We detail the pivotal role Cole Palmer played in helping the Blues get our Premier League campaign up and running with a victory at Fulham. Our No10 was at his very best at Craven Cottage. Palmer assisted and scored a goal in the same Premier League game for the first time since February’s draw with Leeds United, with his cute finish early in the second half ultimately settling the contest. That was one of a game-high five attempts Palmer registered against Fulham, while he also led the way for successful dribbles (five), duels won (10), touches in the opposition box (nine) and fouls won (three). All those statistics point to the intent and confidence with which Palmer played. His nine attempted take-ons showed just how keen he was to beat his man, with one twisting and turning run in the second half nearly culminating in a special solo strike. Xabi Alonso’s system, using Palmer in a pocket alongside Morgan Rogers and off Joao Pedro, helped our No10 receive the ball. He spent more time in possession than every Chelsea outfielder bar Reece James, Josh Acheampong and Morgan Lacroix. Palmer was consistently effective when he had the ball at his feet. His assist for Joao Pedro’s record-breaking goal – the fastest ever scored in the Premier League on an opening weekend – was one of three key passes Palmer played, a figure bettered only by Rogers’ five. In total, Palmer completed 88 per cent of his passes, significantly higher than the team average of 82 per cent. A significant proportion (14) were played in the final third, too, highlighting his willingness to take risks. The weight and direction of Palmer’s passes were pivotal to our first and second goals, while his own strike showed his pinpoint accuracy in front of goal. The angle was narrow, so he aimed to slip the ball through Bernd Leno’s legs – and succeeded. Palmer wasn’t afraid to do his defensive work, either. He won two tackles and recovered possession seven times, including on three occasions in the final third. Those high turnovers proved instrumental for our first two goals of the night. Palmer was ably assisted by Joao Pedro and Rogers. That trio played 20 passes between them and showed signs of an understanding that bodes very well for the future – as does Palmer’s elite display. Up next is our midweek Carabao Cup clash against Luton Town and Alonso's Premier League home debut against Brighton & Hove Albion. news.body_zh: 我们详细介绍了科尔·帕尔默在帮助蓝军启动并在富勒姆取得胜利的英超联赛中所发挥的关键作用。我们的 10 号在 Craven Cottage 处于最佳状态。自二月份战平利兹联以来，帕尔默首次在同一场英超比赛中助攻并进球，他在下半场早些时候的可爱射门最终锁定了比赛。这是帕尔默在对阵富勒姆的比赛中全场最高的五次射门之一，同时他还在成功带球（五次）、对抗胜利（十次）、对方禁区触球（九次）和犯规获胜（三次）方面领先。所有这些统计数据都表明了帕尔默打球的意图和信心。他的九次尝试表明了他对击败对手的渴望，下半场的一次转身跑动几乎以一次特殊的单人进攻达到了高潮。哈维·阿隆索的体系，利用帕尔默与摩根·罗杰斯并肩作战，并在若奥·佩德罗的帮助下，帮助我们的 10 号球员接球。除了里斯·詹姆斯、乔什·阿奇姆彭和摩根·拉克鲁瓦之外，他控球的时间比所有切尔西外野手都多。当球在脚下时，帕尔默始终保持高效。他为若奥·佩德罗破纪录的进球（英超联赛首周末进球速度最快的进球）的助攻是帕尔默的三记关键传球之一，这一数字仅次于罗杰斯的五记传球。总的来说，帕尔默的传球完成率为88%，明显高于球队平均水平82%。很大一部分（14）也出现在最后三分之一，这凸显了他愿意冒险的意愿。帕尔默传球的力度和方向对于我们的第一个和第二个进球至关重要，而他自己的射门则显示了他在球门前的精准。角度很窄，所以他打算把球从贝恩德·莱诺的腿上滑过——并且成功了。帕尔默也不害怕做他的防守工作。他赢得了两次铲断并七次夺回控球权，其中三次是在进攻三区。事实证明，这些高失误对我们当晚的前两个进球起到了重要作用。帕尔默得到若昂·佩德罗和罗杰斯的大力协助。这三人一共传球 20 次，表现出默契的迹象，这对未来来说是个好兆头——帕尔默的精英表现也是如此。接下来是周中联赛杯对阵卢顿镇的比赛，以及阿隆索对阵布莱顿的英超主场首秀。立即获得 VIP 体验，与切尔西俱乐部度过难忘的斯坦福桥比赛日！
